<a id="scene0_bitmap_packed"></a>
### [`scene0_bitmap_packed`](../../../src/scene0_packed_a.asm#L6) `$3994-$3995`

*data*

The unpacker reads control bytes from the end down to the $00 terminator that follows the word. $01-$7f copies that many bytes that come before the control byte. $81-$ff repeats the byte before it (value AND $7f) times. The output fills $f53f down to $e640, 3840 bytes, bitmap rows 5-16.

- **Entry of:** [`scene_packed_ptrs`](../tables.md#scene_packed_ptrs)
